question.text:
The dimension of $\sqrt{\frac{\mu_0}{\epsilon_0}}$ is equal to that of :
( $\mu_0=$ Vacuum permeability and $\epsilon_0=$ Vacuum permittivity)

solution.text: $\begin{aligned} & L=\frac{\mu_0 N A}{\ell} \\ & C=\frac{A \epsilon_0}{d} \\ & \frac{L}{C} \propto \frac{\mu_0}{\epsilon_0} \\ & \sqrt{\frac{\mu_0}{\epsilon_0}} \propto \sqrt{\frac{L}{C}} \\ & \frac{L}{C}=\frac{\tau R}{(\tau / R)}=R^2 \\ & \sqrt{\frac{\mu_0}{\epsilon_0}}=R\end{aligned}$
